data.exact_reserve_text: An overall release of prior year's provisions for claims during the year of approximately GBP 19.0m (2015: release of GBP 37.6m) was primarily driven by the favourable experience on the Marine accounts in Aviation and Marine of GBP 26.5m (2015: release of GBP 54.7m), and Property and Fire release of GBP 0.5m (2015: release of GBP 5.3m). This is offset by the adverse experience on the Public Liability accounts in Third Party Liability of GBP 11.0m (2015: strengthening of GBP 23.4m).

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported an overall release of prior years' claims provisions of approximately GBP 19.0m in 2016 (2015: release GBP 37.6m). The release was primarily driven by favourable prior-year experience in Aviation and Marine (GBP 26.5m) and a small release in Property & Fire (GBP 0.5m), partly offset by adverse development in Public Liability/Third Party Liability (GBP 11.0m). The net effect is a release of reserves, equivalent to roughly a 3.4% reduction versus opening gross claims outstanding.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Technical provisions: Claims outstanding) 2015 comparative column. Prior year movement taken from the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' narrative which explicitly states a GBP 19.0m release (treated as gross). Segmental premium mix taken from the Segmental Analysis table (2016 gross premiums written). A gross claims development triangle (gross) is present on page 34 and was used for cross-check; it includes an '2010 & Prior' aggregate column which was excluded per rules. Some negative premium line items (e.g. Accident and health, Marine) are printed as negative in the segmental table; values copied verbatim. Triangle extraction from scanned image may carry minor transcription uncertainty; triangle provided in thousands as printed.
